list.name: home_id
list.label: Homes
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT home_id FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY 1

list.name: plug_id
list.label: Plugs (non-general)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT plug_id FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AND plug_id <> 'general' AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: single_home
list.label: Home (for plug breakdown)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT home_id FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSQL:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(energy_kwh), 0) AS total_kwh
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND plug_id = 'general'
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT total_kwh AS value FROM s

WITH hourly_load AS (
  SELECT
    window_start,
    SUM(avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf) / 1000.0 AS kw
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND plug_id = 'general'
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(kw), 0) AS value FROM hourly_load

WITH s AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(energy_kwh), 0) AS total_kwh
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND plug_id = 'general'
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
),
d AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(1.0, (${__to:date:seconds} - ${__from:date:seconds}) / 86400.0) AS days
)
SELECT (s.total_kwh / d.days) AS value
FROM s CROSS JOIN d

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT home_id) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})

SELECT

SELECT

  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT
  home_id,
  SUM(energy_kwh) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1

LIMIT ${top_n}

SELECT
  plug_id AS metric,
  SUM(energy_kwh) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id = ${single_home:sqlstring}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Consistency Check (W) – ${single_home}: general vs Σ plugs (10-min)

targets.rawSQL:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    window_start AS t,
    MAX(CASE WHEN plug_id = 'general' THEN avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf END) AS home_w,
    SUM(CASE WHEN plug_id <> 'general' THEN avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf END) AS sum_plugs_w
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
    AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND home_id = ${single_home:sqlstring}
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t AS time, home_w AS value, 'home_general_w' AS metric FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT t AS time, sum_plugs_w AS value, 'sum_plugs_w' AS metric FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT t AS time, (home_w - sum_plugs_w) AS value, 'diff_w' AS metric FROM agg
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT
  window_start AS time,
  AVG(avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf) AS value,
  CONCAT(home_id, '/', plug_id) AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Hour-of-Day × Day-of-Week (Avg W) – table (pivot to heatmap)

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  day_of_week(window_start) AS day_of_week,
  hour(window_start) AS hour_of_day,
  AVG(avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf) AS avg_w
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT
  date_trunc('month', window_start) AS time,
  SUM(energy_kwh) AS value,
  'monthly_kwh' AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  COALESCE(date_diff('second', MAX(ts), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 0) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND ts >= CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE AS TIMESTAMP(3))
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})

SELECT
  100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN avg_voltage < 210 OR avg_voltage > 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
      / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})

SELECT
  COALESCE(AVG(avg_pf), 0) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})

SELECT
  COALESCE(AVG(avg_voltage), 0) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})

SELECT
  window_start AS time,
  SUM(samples) / 10.0 AS value,
  CASE WHEN plug_id = 'general' THEN 'general_events' ELSE 'plug_events' END AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  ts,
  home_id,
  plug_id,
  voltage,
  current_amp,
  power_factor,
  (COALESCE(voltage,0) * COALESCE(current_amp,0) * COALESCE(power_factor,0)) AS real_power_w,
  energy_wh
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND ts >= CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE AS TIMESTAMP(3))
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 100
